events.title: NYE Gala Dinner:Fun,Food, Drinks
events.description:
Celebrate New Year's Eve like Never Before at our spectacular Dinner Gala at Amritara Resort Goa. Enjoy a Lavish Buffet featuring a wide variety of Live Counters and Starters, and toast to 2026 with our Premium well stock Bar. Dance the night away with the sounds of the Live Band- Know Singer Mr. Vishwajeet Singh from Mumbai and DJ Akshay & MC Mr. Dharmendra from Goa, culminating in a breathtaking Midnight Fireworks display , Champagne Toast & Cake Cutting on New Year Celebration in Goa Style!
Venue: Pool Side New Year Eve Celebration 2026 
Event Highlights:
DJ Night - Groove to the beats and dance into the New Year
Live Singer Performance - Enjoy soulful live music under the stars

Live Music Extravaganza - Enjoy soulful live performances to elevate your NYE vibe
Celebrity Emcee - Keeping the energy high and the night unforgettable with Couple games & fun
Live Barbeque - Cozy warmth, smoky Veg , Non-Veg grills & Seafood .
Access of Kids Game zone – Snooker , Table Tennis & other games available 
Lavish Gala Dinner - Multi-cuisine buffet with live counters
Premium Drinks- Unlimited Lip Smacking Cocktail & Mocktails - Celebrate with your favourite pour of Premium Liquors from our well stock Bar
Games & Fun Activities - Exciting games, prizes & surprises to all guest
Chaat Counter - A Street Food Delight
Live Counter – Indian Traditional Chat (Pani Poori , Dahi Poori , Bhel Poori & Papdi Chaat). Pav Bhaji , Pizza & Chinse Counter
Ambient, Mouth-Melting Kebabs and Snacks Buffet
Unlimited Lavish, Widespread Grand Buffet
Special Bollywood-Themed Event with Loads of Fun
Exciting Prizes and Gifts to Win for Couples & Kids 
Free on Site Car Parking for all Guest

UNLIMITED BEVERAGES:
Whiskey: Black Label, Chivas Regal, Ballantine's, 100 Pipers Deluxe, or Similar Scotch

events.title: Jungle's Monday Open Mic
events.description:
Hey! 🙋‍♀️

Today step into the electrifying JBS Vagator *Monday Open Mic*!🎤

Join us tonight at the courtyard for a creative explosion. Express yourself with songs, poetry, and improv acts on our open stage. 

Hosted by the fabulous *Sushant* joined by a crew of talented artists, musicians, actors, rappers, percussionists, and poets, this stage has seen 500+ mind-blowing performances! Grab the mic, enjoy drinks, and dive into the vibrant atmosphere. 🕺🏻💃🏻

Join us *6:00 PM onwards* for an evening of sensational acts, yummy drinks, scrumptious food, and enchanting tunes. 🎶🎵 Let's raise a toast to art and community! 🥂
